hook.text: The lake has a landing zone, a processing zone, and a consumption zone. Each has different rules and access.

buildup.text: The landing zone receives raw data. The processing zone transforms it. The consumption zone serves users.

discovery.text: Zones separate concerns: ingestion teams own landing, engineers own processing, analysts own consumption.

twist.text: Cross-zone access must be controlled. Analysts should read gold, not accidentally query raw landing data.

climax.text: Clear zones with defined ownership and access policies prevent the lake from becoming a swamp.

punchline.text: Separate zones. Clear owners. Controlled access.

quiz.question: Why should data lake zones have separate access controls?
options: To prevent users from accidentally querying raw, unvalidated data
Zones don't need separate access controls
